answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 37985 Country: India Title: Duwa for getting things easy and good health of mother and child during and after ceserian delivery Question: My wife is pregnant for third child. There were complications in 1st and 2nd pregnancy so I need some dua for getting things easy and good health of mother and child during and after delivery. Answer ID: 37985 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 663/567/B=1433) You and your wife should keep on reciting the below dua: اللھم لا سھل الا ما جعلتہ سھلا وانت تجعل الحزن سھلا اذا شئت All the troubles will go away inshaAllah! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
